title: Edits, an empty score, a new time signature, device drift and clock jumps while following
description:
As a performer, I want edits and awkward cases to behave predictably while Apricity follows a clock, so that nothing surprises me on stage.

Spec file: `features/link/clock.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: Edits and edge cases while following a beat clock

  Background:
    Given playback of the click score is following a clock at 120 BPM with a quantum of 4

  Scenario: An edit lands on the clock's next bar line
    When I load an edited arrangement at beat 9.5
    Then it starts sounding at beat 12 within the tolerance, with the 5 ms crossfade

  Scenario: An empty score keeps following in silence
    Given a score with no tracks
    When I start playback following the clock
    Then nothing sounds and no error is reported
    When I load an arrangement with tracks at beat 5
    Then its bar 1 sounds at beat 8

  Scenario: A new time signature changes the quantum at the swap
    When I load an arrangement in 3/4 at beat 9
    Then it starts at beat 12 and from then on its bar 1 comes every 12 beats (4 bars of 3)
    And the clock's quantum becomes 3

  Scenario: The audio device runs slightly fast
    Given the audio device's clock runs 0.05% faster than the beat clock
    When playback follows the clock for 10 minutes
    Then every click sounds on the beat within the tolerance

  Scenario: The clock jumps
    When the clock's beat jumps ahead by 0.75 of a beat
    Then playback re-aligns within one 5 ms crossfade
    And every later click sounds on the beat within the tolerance
```
